result.summary: Internal campaign request form initiated by Lynnette Stevens on 21-Jan-00 (dated as 'Date Initiated') and addressed to Kelli Scruggs, with copies to Vincent Losito, George Baroody, Don Kisling, S. Tesh, and C. Will. It requests a direct mail coupon campaign for the Newport Parent, Lights & 120's brands targeting competitive smokers aged 21–34, with approximate circulation of 600,000 across Tiers II & IV (a list of states is given). The coupon value is $1.50 off a pack, with a coupon issue date of 4/14/00 and expiration date of 9/30/00. A control-use section assigns code 05787 and an estimated redemption rate of 13%; the job number field is blank.
